---
title: "OpenCode + gpt-oss"
---

([Back to the choices](setup.qmd).)

gpt-oss needs 16 GB of memory and about 20 GB of free disk space.

**Install Ollama, gpt-oss, and OpenCode.** Paste the block into PowerShell (Windows) or Terminal (Mac). The model download takes a while.

**On Windows**:

```powershell
irm https://ollama.com/install.ps1 | iex
ollama pull gpt-oss:20b
winget install SST.opencode
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$HOME\.config\opencode" | Out-Null
@'
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "ollama": {
      "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible",
      "name": "Ollama (local)",
      "options": { "baseURL": "http://localhost:11434/v1" },
      "models": {
        "gpt-oss:20b": { "name": "gpt-oss 20B (local)" }
      }
    }
  }
}
'@ | Set-Content "$HOME\.config\opencode\opencode.json"
```

**On Mac**:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
ollama pull gpt-oss:20b
curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode
cat > ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json <<'EOF'
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "provider": {
    "ollama": {
      "npm": "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible",
      "name": "Ollama (local)",
      "options": { "baseURL": "http://localhost:11434/v1" },
      "models": {
        "gpt-oss:20b": { "name": "gpt-oss 20B (local)" }
      }
    }
  }
}
EOF
```

**Set the context length.** Click the Ollama icon (in the menu bar on a Mac, or the system tray on Windows) > *Settings*, and move the *Context length* slider to *32k*.

**Check.** Open a new terminal window and run

```sh
opencode run --model ollama/gpt-oss:20b "Reply with only the word hello."
```

It should print `hello`. (It can take a minute or two.) Then go to [A First Example](first-example.qmd).
